# ELCAMOSO

> ELCAMOSO (www.elcamoso.com) is a web app that turns the motion of an electric car into sound. It runs in the Tesla in-car browser and on phones, and plays engine-style, symphony, world and fusion sound experiences that follow your speed and acceleration. Early access is free. ELCAMOSO is not related to the Chevrolet El Camino.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.elcamoso.com/): what ELCAMOSO is and how to start
- [Sounds](https://www.elcamoso.com/sounds): engine sound profiles for EVs
- [Symphony](https://www.elcamoso.com/symphony): music that follows your drive
- [Worlds](https://www.elcamoso.com/worlds): nature and city soundscapes
- [Fusion](https://www.elcamoso.com/fusion): mixed experiences
- [Pricing](https://www.elcamoso.com/pricing): free early access and Drive+
- [Science](https://www.elcamoso.com/science): how motion becomes sound, plus safety and security
- [Crew](https://www.elcamoso.com/crew): Smiles, levels and leaderboard
- [News](https://www.elcamoso.com/news): latest updates
- [Story](https://www.elcamoso.com/story): the idea behind ELCAMOSO
- [Credits](https://www.elcamoso.com/credits): sound credits and licences
